newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ fires "pyramid" warning shot at Endeavour Plan.
newsitem.headline: NZ fires "pyramid" warning shot at Endeavour Plan.

text.p: New Zealand's Commerce Commission, which monitors competition and compliance with fair trading rules, said on Wednesday it believed a retirement savings scheme on offer through Endeavour International Limited contained a pyramid selling element and promotion should stop.

"With all the current publicity about the need to save for retirement, promoting the pyramid selling option of the Endeavour Plan as a retirement plan was particularly unfair," Fair Trading Manager Rachel Leamy said in a statement.
New Zealand is currently studying the possibility of moving to a privately-funded compulsory superannuation scheme and the private pensions industry is growing rapidly.
"The vast majority of people in pyramid selling schemes lose out. There just aren't enough people to keep them going," Leamy noted, adding that all pyramid selling is illegal here.
Endeavour International, promoters of the scheme, did not appear to have gone beyond distributing promotional material and selling booklets about the plan, the commission said.
It added that it had warned Endeavour that if it continued promoting the scheme the agency would consider taking court action to stop it.

Furthermore, complaints have been made to the Securities Commission about two aspects of a purported unit trust element to the Endeavour Plan which have led to that body issuing a prohibition order preventing the plan's promotion.

The plan could have misled potential investors into believing it had been set up in accordance with the Unit Trust Act when in fact it had not, and the brochure falsely claimed Guardian Trust and BZW & Barclay were the plan's fund managers when neither company was.

Pyramid schemes have spread widely in the newly-liberalised economies of eastern Europe in recent years and have also caused widespread problems for ill-advised small investors in developing nations in Africa and Latin America.
